xyz.rationale: theta is consumed EVERY iteration by the full-N culling projection (radii computation). A deferred zero-grad Adam transition still moves theta (m decays by beta1, v by beta2, update = -lr*m_hat/(sqrt(v_hat)+eps) is nonzero in general), so theta at step t is only exact if all transitions up to t-1 are applied. Under the v1 exactness model (per-step replay, no closed form), materializing theta every step requires m/v every step -> full dense traffic. VOS v1 gains nothing here.

rotation.rationale: Same as xyz: culling passes quats to fully_fused_projection for the full-N projected-radius test every iteration.
rotation.theta_consumer_scope: ALL_ROWS every iteration (culling) + VISIBLE_ROWS (producer, projection VJP)

scaling.rationale: Same as xyz: culling passes scales to fully_fused_projection every iteration.
scaling.mv_consumer_scope: optimizer only + topology events (also read ALL_ROWS by clone/split percent_dense selection)

opacity.rationale: theta is NOT read by culling. Per-iteration consumers (producer, raster, blend VJP) read only VISIBLE rows. Rows not in visible_ids have NO theta consumer in a normal iteration. Deferred zero-grad transitions can be replayed at the next visibility event (row becomes visible) before the producer reads theta. Topology events are GLOBAL_FENCE: prune mask depends on get_opacity of ALL rows; reset_opacity reads/writes all rows; clone/split copy selected rows.
opacity.theta_consumer_scope: VISIBLE_ROWS per iteration; ALL_ROWS at densify/reset/ckpt/eval fences
opacity.source_evidence: culling omits opacities (c0_gaussian_inference.py L721-736); producer visible-only (L2070-2085); densify prune mask (gaussian_model.py L583); reset_opacity (L614-625)

shs.rationale: theta is NOT read by culling. Per-iteration consumers (producer SH eval, SH VJP) read only VISIBLE rows (active SH prefix only). No opacity-reset fence needed (reset touches the opacity attribute only). Largest tensor: 48/59 = 81.4% of Adam elements at degree 3.
shs.theta_consumer_scope: VISIBLE_ROWS per iteration (active degree prefix); selected rows at clone/split; ALL_ROWS at ckpt/eval fences
shs.source_evidence: culling omits colors (L721-736); producer visible-only with colors_input (L2074); clone/split copy shs of selected (gaussian_model.py L477, L533)

exactness_model_implications.visible_set_invariance: C_t (visible_ids) is computed from xyz/rotation/scaling theta only, which are EAGER (always physically exact under VOS v1). Therefore C_t is bit-identical between dense baseline and VOS. Materialization of opacity/SH for C_t at the start of iteration t does not change any decision downstream.
exactness_model_implications.invisible_row_gradient: In the dense baseline, rows not in C_t receive gradient EXACTLY 0.0 (full-N zeros_like grad buffer + scatter of visible rows only). Their Adam transition is the zero-grad transition: m*=beta1 (via lerp_), v*=beta2 (+addcmul_ of 0), theta -= lr(s)*m_hat/(sqrt(v_hat)+eps) with bias correction at logical step s. Replay of these transitions is exact.
exactness_model_implications.per_row_independence: All Adam ops are elementwise; no cross-row coupling in any transition. Replay on a row subset reproduces per-row bit patterns when the same op sequence and scalars are used.
exactness_model_implications.bias_correction: torch Adam's step counter is per-PARAMETER-TENSOR and increments once per optimizer.step() (trainer calls step exactly once per iteration, publication_trainer.py L561). Replay of logical step s must use bias_correction with s (host-side double scalars, same values as baseline).
exactness_model_implications.lr_schedule: xyz lr = f(s) at logical step s (schedule is a pure function of iteration); other attrs constant. Replay uses lr_attr(s).

phase1_region_15k_30k.topology: FROZEN (densify_until_iter=15000; no clone/split/prune, no opacity reset after 15K — trainer gates both on iteration < densify_until_iter)
phase1_region_15k_30k.note: Phase-1 (SH-only virtualization) applies here. Opacity virtualization joins in Phase-2. No densification fence exists in this region, so the event structure is minimal.
